purpose: Bind every live author gate, identify cross-candidate conflicts and derive the shortest safe decision/preparation/freeze sequence before S6-E0. This audit does not choose an option for the author, authorize any candidate, modify frozen artifacts, implement code or execute an optimizer/evaluator.

passport_intake.interpretation: The passport is a historical Stage-2 placeholder and is not current Stage-6 authority. It must not be silently rewritten or used to release S6-E0.

bound_gates.scope: Freeze and independently restore the already selected M=2,000D per-run budget and fixed-checkpoint H1 endpoint precedence layer.
Select the canonical full name and authorize additive post-freeze runtime-provenance preparation only.
Select a SHADE 1.1.1 plus Deb-2000 project-composite parent and prepare parent-conformance amendment/red contracts only.
Select COCO bbob-constrained and external baselines and prepare matrix/spec/red contracts only.
Acknowledge Ray/Ming precursors, add a Ray-style same-parent control and narrow the claim; preparation/red contracts only.
Select resolutions for 5 critical and 5 major mathematical/measurement gaps; preparation/red contracts only.
Select run-to-seed-to-problem estimators, CRN-A12, exact inference, multiplicity and missingness; preparation/red contracts only.

integration_findings.title: The six-item waiting list omitted the unresolved canonical-name and runtime-provenance decisions
integration_findings.evidence: The full-contract audit records C-METHOD-FULL-NAME and P-LIVE-REGISTRY-DRIFT/P-HISTORICAL-AUTH-FIELDS. The M/H freeze candidate explicitly refuses to infer N/S, and the parent candidate explicitly keeps the CVGR name unresolved.
integration_findings.consequence: Confirming the previous six items still cannot create a complete runtime authority or release S6-E0.
integration_findings.resolution: Add a separately scoped NS decision gate and bind it in any consolidated author packet.

integration_findings.title: The mandatory Ray-style novelty control changes the frozen variant matrix and planned FFE totals
integration_findings.evidence: The frozen M matrix contains seven variants and C1 contains four. NV requires a clean-room same-parent equal-FFE Ray-style control before a graph-specific contribution can be defended.
integration_findings.boundary: These are deterministic plan arithmetic values, not execution or performance evidence. The exact Ray placement still requires a versioned matrix amendment.
integration_findings.resolution: The NV amendment must state whether Ray is M-only, C1-only, both or exploratory. If it supports the narrowed main mechanism/performance claim, it must enter both relevant confirmatory families and supersede total-budget arithmetic without changing the selected 2,000D per-run M budget.

integration_findings.title: The statistical amendment cannot be frozen before the final comparator and benchmark matrices
integration_findings.evidence: SA defines H1-H3 global multiplicity and missingness families, while NV adds a mandatory primary control and BM adds a separate modern benchmark/baseline family.
integration_findings.consequence: Freezing SA first would immediately stale its comparison family, Holm membership, run counts and missingness denominators.
integration_findings.resolution: Authorize SA decisions now if desired, but prepare/freeze the operative statistical amendment only after PA, NV, MI and BM matrices/specifications are frozen.

integration_findings.title: Post-freeze runtime authority must be the final composition layer, not an early partial binding
integration_findings.evidence: NS must bind the accepted plan plus every effective additive amendment and implementation authorization. Six scientific/implementation amendments are still pending.
integration_findings.consequence: Freezing runtime authority before its inputs creates another stale authority manifest and repeats the existing provenance defect.
integration_findings.resolution: Prepare the NS schema early, but populate and freeze its operative runtime-authority manifest only after all required amendments are independently frozen and restored.

integration_findings.title: Unnamespaced decision codes collide and legacy keep-pending fields conflict with simultaneous confirmation
integration_findings.evidence: P, N, M, F, X and other letters carry different meanings across MH/NS/PA/BM/NV/MI/SA. Several candidates say keep earlier gates pending because they were authored serially.
integration_findings.consequence: A flat combined response can be ambiguous or accidentally preserve an obsolete unresolved state.
integration_findings.resolution: Use gate-prefixed codes such as MH.P, NS.N, PA.P, BM.B, NV.B, MI.J and SA.U. Preserve scope independence, but explicitly supersede only the stale keep-pending markers when the same hash-bound packet confirms those gates.

integration_findings.title: The passport cannot currently serve as the authorization or Stage-6 completion ledger
integration_findings.evidence: Live intake returns resume, evidence_state=PLANNED, validation=WARN and next_action=Stage 2, while project-local governance shows later frozen plan and implementation evidence.
integration_findings.consequence: Using the passport as if current would either regress the project to Stage 2 or falsely promote PLANNED to VERIFIED.
integration_findings.resolution: Keep the passport unchanged in this packet. After all author decisions and additive freezes, prepare a separate hash-bound ledger-reconciliation authorization rather than silently rewriting it.

safe_sequence.effect: Record all seven independent choices in one hash-bound message; no preparation, freeze or execution is inferred beyond the listed scopes.
Make only 2,000D per-run M budget and fixed-checkpoint H1 timing authoritative; later NV may add a variant and supersede total FFE arithmetic.
Prepare parent identity/conformance, canonical name schema and mechanism-integrity specs/red fixtures; each remains proposed until separately frozen.
Fix Ray-control placement, exact M/C1/C2/modern matrices, benchmark families, run counts and revised planned FFE totals.
Independently freeze parent, mechanism, novelty and modern-matrix amendments; no production or execution authority.
Bind final estimands, aggregation, comparison families, exact tests, missingness and result schema.

depends_on: all effective amendments frozen and restored
safe_sequence.effect: Create one current machine provenance manifest without editing historical evidence.
Only then may a new expected-red S6-E0 candidate be prepared; still no production implementation or evaluator execution.

depends_on: red contracts frozen and red evidence verified
safe_sequence.effect: Production/analysis green implementation, dependencies, pilot, formal M, C1/F, modern suite and any paper-bearing execution each require later independent hash-bound authorization.

parallelism_boundary.author_decisions: May be confirmed together because every selection is explicitly namespaced and independently hash-bound.
parallelism_boundary.preparation: PA/MI/NV/BM specification work may partly overlap after decisions, but their effective freeze order must respect the dependency graph.
parallelism_boundary.freeze: Separate immutable candidates and empty-directory restores are required; a consolidated author decision is not a consolidated freeze.
parallelism_boundary.execution: No optimizer/evaluator, result reading or formal FFE is authorized anywhere in this audit.

verdict.next_safe_action: Prepare one hash-bound, namespaced consolidated author decision packet that preserves all production/execution holds.
